name: Confessing Sin
overview: Scripture teaches that confessing sin is essential for receiving God's mercy and forgiveness, as those who hide their sins will not prosper, but those who confess and forsake them will be shown mercy (Proverbs 28:13). True confession involves acknowledging faults openly, as believers are encouraged to confess their sins to one another and pray for healing (James 5:16). The blood of Christ purges the conscience from dead works, enabling believers to serve God with a clean heart (Hebrews 9:14), and God promises to remember sins no more when He is merciful to unrighteousness (Hebrews 8:12). Confession also aligns with the confession of faith in Christ as Lord, which is necessary for salvation (Romans 10:9).
